test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe. Together the two pipes can fill the tank in 32 minutes. The slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in _______ minutes.
solution:
Given:

One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe, and together they can fill the tank in 32 minutes.

Concept:

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Total work = Efficiency × time

Calculation:

The ratio of efficiency of two pipes = 3: 1

Total work = (3 + 1) × 32

⇒ 4 × 32 = 128

Time taken by slower pipe alone = 128/1

⇒ 128 min

∴ The slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in 128 min.
